summary_en: 110,000 shares (6.84% of S/O) to be acquired via N-NET3 off-hours trading on 2026-06-16 at ¥685/share (closing price 2026-06-15), up to ¥75.35M total. Settlement same day.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (N-NET3)
translation_en_brief: On 15 June 2026, the Board of Directors of Nippon OA Kenkyusho (5241) resolved to acquire up to 110,000 treasury shares (6.84% of 1,608,000 shares outstanding excluding treasury) via off-hours trading on the Nagoya Exchange. The acquisition will be executed on 16 June 2026 at the closing price of 685 yen per share on 15 June, resulting in an upper limit commitment of ¥75,350,000. The order will be placed in the N-NET3 off-hours session only; no alternative trading method or window is contemplated. Results will be disclosed after the 8:45 a.m. execution window closes. The company states the rationale as enhancing capital efficiency and enabling flexible capital policy in response to changes in the business environment.
